document.abstract: This report of the Progress Committee covers the period October, 1930, to May, 1931. The important advances in the cinematographic art which are described are classified as follows: (1) Production, (2) Distribution, (3) Exhibition, (4) Applications of Motion Pictures, (5) Color Photography, (6) Amateur Cinematography, (7) Statistics, (8) Publications and New Books.
